Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Music by the Main on Whitsun Sunday

May 24, 2026 · KNAUS Camping Park, Frickenhausen am Main

At the invitation of Knaus Camping Park Frickenhausen, CMI will present a benefit concert on Whitsun Sunday at 3:00 pm in the open-air theatre there. Joining the event are the singers of the Ukrainian vocal ensemble FAINO and the two African artists Bénédicte Ndota and André Mabiala.
Admission free. More information about the full festival is available at knauscamp.de.
